fda.text: As in the case of all medications, keep out of reach of children.

summary: Official drug guidance warns to keep ascorbic acid out of the reach of children, as is recommended for all medicines [3]. In addition, a small computer model, rather than tests conducted in people, estimated low risk scores of 28 for the liver and 10 for the heart [M]. Several clinical studies evaluating this drug were stopped early due to low patient enrollment or too few key events occurring during the trial [5][6][7].
